snippet.title: Dungeon of the Forgotten King - Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Dungeon of the Forgotten King is a single-player turn-based #roguelite  RPG #indiegame that combines pixel art with 3D graphics. 🎮

You awaken in a mysterious dungeon with no memory of how you arrived. A magical camp serves as your safe haven, where you can level up, heal, change classes, and obtain equipment before venturing deeper into the dungeon.

Combat is the core of the game. Defeat enemies to earn Gold and Loot, but each consecutive battle increases both the rewards and the difficulty. Spend your resources wisely, as death is permanent.

Even after death, your progress continues through Soul Gems, a permanent progression system that unlocks upgrades for future runs.

Face powerful Dungeon Bosses to gain unique run-long bonuses and eventually challenge the Dungeon Master to escape. Along the way, discover random events, play camp mini-games for extra rewards, and battle a wide variety of enemies in a constantly evolving dungeon.

⚔️ 🛡️ ⚔️

🎮 If you are interested in Dungeon of the Forgotten King, be sure to check it on #steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/770760/Dungeon_of_the_Forgotten_King/

🌐 And just in case, here are our socials: https://linktr.ee/crazygoatstudios
